newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago NBD plans Internet bank.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago NBD plans Internet bank.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp, the ninth largest bank in the U.S., said Monday it plans in 1997 to open a "virtual bank" on the Internet as more and more of its customers are choosing to bank online.

Initially, the financial services company plans to offer online access to bank account balances, transfers and history of accounts. These services are expected to be followed by mortgage access and bill payment, a company spokesman said.
Future plans include the ability to make purchases over the Internet, First Chicago NBD said in its annual report.
The 1996 year represents the first full year of operations for the merged First Chicago Corp and NBD Bancorp.

First Chicago NBD's Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Verne Istock earned $774,416 in salary and received a bonus of $1 million in 1996, according to a proxy statement for the company's May 9, 1997 annual shareholders meeting.
This compares with Istock's salary of $746,154 and a bonus of $550,000 in 1995.

Reviewing its 1996 operations, First Chicago NBD said its regional banking business accounted for more than 40 percent of the company's total 1996 earnings of $1.44 billion and "growth prospects for this business are very attractive."

First Chicago NBD's corporate and institutional banking and corporate investments businesses generated about one-third of total 1996 earnings. Corporate and institutional banking results were slightly below those of 1995 and largely due to disappointing trading results, the company said.
First Chicago NBD said significant initiatives are underway to streamline this business and boost overall profitability.

The company's credit card business provided almost one-quarter of total earnings. Declining consumer credit quality and increasing delinquencies affected operations, the company said. In response, the credit card operation has implemented changes to improve the company's risk profile, First Chicago NBD said.
